svg.text: Engineering evidence search: MVP system design
A chat agent or the web page calls one search function · FTS5 inverted index · permissions before answers, counts and pages · each answer is exact text from one file, with its source
QUERY PLANE · ONLINE · EACH QUESTION IN UNDER 10 S
Search p50 16 ms, p95 70 ms · acceptance test: each question < 10 s
The chat agent adds its own LLM time
answer · file · page · lines · SHA-256 version · request ID
SQLite files · the web service and MCP server can share them
structured + keyword store · WAL · one transaction per update
INGESTION PLANE · AT START, ON REINDEX AND ON UPLOAD
Install and test the MCP server
Full guide: docs/MCP.md · Python 3.11+ and uv · the chat client starts the server on your computer and talks to it over stdio
uv run --frozen python -m scripts.check_mcp --user kamal → ends with “The MCP server works.”
claude mcp add engineering-search-jp -- uv run --frozen --directory "$PWD" python -m engineering_search.mcp_server --user jp
Add one server per user (jp, kamal, maya). Ask the questions in docs/MCP.md as each user. Report the request_id of each problem.
Kamal must get no text, file name or count from project-northgate/ or specifications/. Report it at once if Kamal does.
The server trusts --user. It does not match the person who uses the MCP client to the file permissions. Anyone who can edit the client configuration can read as JP.
Fix before real restricted files: remote MCP server with OAuth sign-in, user from the token, permissions from the repository.
Measured on every change with scripts.evaluate and pytest, not judged by eye
